item.title: Hollywood Producer Hid A Deadly Double Life
item.description: Sam Haskell III appeared to have a privileged Hollywood life, but investigators say it concealed a horrific crime. After his wife Mei Haskell disappeared, evidence led police to uncover a brutal murder case that shocked Los Angeles and exposed the dark secrets behind a well-known entertainment family.

item.title: She Was Found Dead In Her School Bathroom
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Ta'ir Rada was found murdered inside her school's bathroom in Israel in 2006. The investigation led to a controversial conviction, years of appeals, disputed forensic evidence, and intense public debate, making it one of the country's most divisive and closely followed criminal cases.

item.title: The Strange Disappearance That Still Has No Answers
item.description: Twelve-year-old Johnny Gosch vanished while delivering newspapers in Iowa in 1982, becoming one of America's most infamous missing child cases. Decades later, conflicting witness accounts, conspiracy theories, and unanswered questions continue to fuel one of the most mysterious disappearances in true crime history.

item.title: The Questions That Still Haunt Sean Daugherty's Death
item.description: After Sean Daugherty died during a police encounter, officials ruled on what happened—but his family never accepted those conclusions. Alleged inconsistencies, disputed evidence, and years of unanswered questions have kept the case at the center of a growing debate over accountability and transparency.

item.title: How Tracy Edwards Stopped Jeffrey Dahmer
item.description: In July 1991, Tracy Edwards escaped from the apartment of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer and flagged down police while still wearing one of Dahmer's handcuffs. His account led officers back to the apartment, where they uncovered evidence of multiple murders, bringing one of America's most notorious serial killing cases to an end.

item.title: The Honeymoon Murder Of Anni Dewani
item.description: Anni Dewani was murdered during her honeymoon in Cape Town, South Africa, in 2010 after the couple's taxi was hijacked. The investigation drew worldwide attention as suspicion fell on her husband, Shrien Dewani, who was later extradited to South Africa to stand trial. He was ultimately acquitted of all charges, leaving the case one of the most controversial honeymoon murder investigations in recent history.
